_about: v2.2 Neutral rework, unit N3 — the REVIEWED edits that give the ACCEPTED draw engine (the frozen hash-pinned copy of HEAD's UpgradeManager.swift) the pool as the rework has changed it so far: N1's three and N2's XP Boost edits unchanged, plus Long Shot's, Scatter's and Fracture Shot's four-tier ladders (N3). Written as the registry's own expressions so the doubles are identical. run.sh refuses a moved engine or an edit that does not match exactly once. Supersedes n2-engine-edits.json (kept as evidence). Moving the engine or changing an edit is a ruling, never a drive-by.

edits.name: Swift: the overlay's three-tier ladder (totals 0.08 / 0.20 / 0.35)
Keen Eye: retired (leaves the pool in place)
Magnetic Core: the overlay's three-tier ladder (radius totals 0.15 / 0.30 / 0.50; burst set to 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30)
edits.replace:
id: "v13_magnetic_core", name: "Magnetic Core", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst",
            apply: { stats in
                stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.15
                stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.10
            },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.30 - 0.15
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.20
                },
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.30
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.30
                }
            ]
        ))

edits.name: XP Boost: the overlay's three-tier ladder (totals 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.50; T3 raises the run cap to 20 and owes one level)
edits.replace:
id: "neutral_5", name: "XP Boost", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+25% XP gain",
            apply: { stats in stats.xpMultiplier += 0.25 },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in stats.xpMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.25 },
                { stats in
                    stats.xpMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.50
                    stats.runLevelCap = max(stats.runLevelCap, 20)
                    stats.grantedLevelsPending += 1
                }
            ]
        ))

edits.name: Long Shot: the overlay's four-tier ladder (range totals 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.50 / 0.50; tiers 1–4)
Scatter: the overlay's four-tier ladder (lanes 2 / 3 / 5 / 9; no spreadAngle write)
Fracture Shot: the overlay's four-tier ladder (fractureTier 1–4; the split fields are gone)
edits.find:
apply: { stats in stats.splitCount = 2 },
            provides: [.pelletEffect],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)
edits.replace:
apply: { stats in stats.fractureTier = 1 },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 2 },
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 3 },
                { stats in stats.fractureTier = 4 }
            ],
            provides: [.pelletEffect],          // v2.1 A7a (CL-93, symmetric)
